properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 11:57AM CDT until August 9 at 12:30PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Lake Michigan nearshore and open waters to mid lake from Sheboygan WI
to Winthrop Harbor IL...

At 1156 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing waterspouts
were located along a line extending from 16 nm east of Port
Washington to near Pleasant Prairie, moving east at 40 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to 40 knots, and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
East southeast of Port Washington
North Point Lighthouse and eastward
Racine
Kenosha.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Sheboygan to Port Washington WI; Port Washington to North Point Light WI; North Point Light to Wind Point WI; Wind Point WI to Winthrop Harbor IL; Lake Michigan from Sheboygan to Port Washington WI 5NM offshore to Mid Lake; Lake Michigan from Port Washington to North Point Light WI 5NM offshore to Mid Lake; Lake Michigan from North Point Light to Wind Point WI 5NM offshore to Mid Lake; Lake Michigan from Wind Point WI to Winthrop Harbor IL 5NM offshore to Mid Lake

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 9 at 12:56PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
At 1256 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Country Club Estates, or near St. Simons Island, moving northeast at
10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts around 40 mph and minor flooding due to heavy
rainfall.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor flooding due to heavy rainfall is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Brunswick, St. Simons Island, Dock Junction, Country Club Estates,
Sea Island, and Boys Estate.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.
properties.area: Inland Glynn; Coastal Glynn; Coastal Camden

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 11:53AM CDT until August 9 at 2:00PM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
SMWLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...

Nearshore Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor...
Open Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor out to Mid
Lake...

* Until 200 PM CDT.

* At 1153 AM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Racine to 10 nm northeast of McHenry to 27 nm
northwest of Elgin, moving east at 35 knots. Storms will be near
the nearshore waters around 1230 PM.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Winthrop Harbor and Waukegan Harbor.
properties.area: Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor IL; Lake Michigan from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor IL 5NM offshore to Mid Lake

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 11:47AM CDT until August 9 at 12:15PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
At 1147 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Sturtevant,
moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Kenosha, Racine, Mount Pleasant, Pleasant Prairie, Sturtevant, Union
Grove, Paddock Lake, Camp Lake, Winthrop Harbor, Twin Lakes, Silver
Lake, Wind Point, Caledonia, Salem, Bristol, Paris, Brighton, Somers,
Elmwood Park, and North Bay.

People attending The Wisconsin Womens Triathlon , and Bristol
Renaissance Faire  should seek safe shelter immediately!
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 9 at 11:40AM CDT until August 9 at 1:45PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of southeast Wisconsin, including the following
counties, Milwaukee, Racine and Waukesha.

* WHEN...Until 145 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1140 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Milwaukee, West Allis, New Berlin, Greenfield, Oak Creek,
Muskego, South Milwaukee, Cudahy, Greendale, St. Francis,
Hales Corners, Franklin, Wind Lake, Vernon, Raymond, Wind
Point, Big Bend, Waterford North, Caledonia and Waterford.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
properties.area: Milwaukee, WI; Racine, WI; Waukesha, WI

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 9 at 11:25AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...

Nearshore Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor...
Open Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor out to Mid
Lake...

At 1124 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated strong thunderstorms, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots. These thunderstorms were
located along a line extending from 15 nm west of Oak Creek to 17 nm
north of McHenry to 36 nm northwest of Elgin, moving southeast at 30
knots. These storms will approach the nearshore around or shortly
after 12 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until these storms pass.

These strong thunderstorms will likely produce winds to around 30
knots, and could pose a serious hazard for boaters. A special marine
warning may eventually be required when these strong thunderstorms
reaches the nearshore waters. Boaters should consider heading for
shore before these strong thunderstorms arrives.
properties.area: Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor IL; Lake Michigan from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor IL 5NM offshore to Mid Lake
